data.title: 冰堂美智留 · 清晨玄关前挂人式的“表弟早安”
data.description: 安芸家清晨阳光普照的玄关前，美智留身后背着沉重的吉他软包，两手一把挂在你脖子上整个人向前扑抱过来，笑容灿烂又大大咧咧，毫无男女边界感。
data.location: bright morning suburban home entrance entryway bathed in golden doorway sunlight
data.action: lunging forward enthusiastically with arms around viewer neck, heavy guitar gig-bag on back, laughing loudly right up close
data.lighting: 大门照入的灿烂清晨朝霞金芒
data.promptProse: Michiru lunges forward at the front door with her heavy guitar gig-bag, wrapping her arms around partner neck with a loud, radiant morning greeting.
data.animaCaption: Golden morning doorway sunbeams halo her short hair as she leans in close with a laughing shout.
